title: A newborn palmar grasp closes the hand around a finger
summary: MedlinePlus says a newborn palmar grasp closes the hand and grips a finger.
body: MedlinePlus lists a palmar hand grasp among primitive reflexes in the newborn to 2 month span. The infant closes the hand and grips a finger that is placed there. The grip is automatic. This card is that early closure of the hand. A purposeful hold that comes months afterward is a different card, and this sentence is not a result for one baby.
